test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the following events in their chronological order.

**A.** Jallianwala Bagh massacre

**B.** Non-Cooperation Movement and Khilafat Movement

**C.** Gandhi-Irwin Pact

**D.** Quit India Movement

**E.** Champaran Movement
solution:
The correct answer is __**E, A, B, C, D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Champaran Movement**: In 1917, the Governor-General was **Lord Chelmsford.**
 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre**: 1919, Governor-General was **Lord Chelmsford.**
 
• **Khilafat Movement**: 1919, Governor-General was **Lord Chelmsford**, **Non-Cooperation Movement**: 1920, Governor-General was **Lord Reading.**
 
• **Gandhi-Irwin Pact**: In 1931, the Governor-General was **Lord Irwin.**
 
• **Quit India Movement**: In 1942, the Governor-General was **Lord Linlithgow**.
